description: List the 32 topics in the commercial glass & glazing knowledge base (glass types, safety glazing codes IBC 2406, storefront/curtain wall, energy codes IECC/ASHRAE 90.1/Title 24, fire-rated, hurricane/impact, wind load ASTM E1300, butt-glazed partitions, railings, sealants, testing, specs, warranties, discontinued products, glass performance data, aluminum system cross-reference, budget pricing). Returns topic numbers, titles, one-line summaries and UNVERIFIED counts. Call this first if you are unsure which topic covers a question. Responses keep the KB's confidence tags: [V] verified, [V-mfr] manufacturer claim, [UNVERIFIED], [inference], [Expert] field experience.

include_sections.description: Also list every section id (e.g. 30.4) per topic. Default false.

name: list_topics

disclaimer.description: Reference-only disclaimer that applies to every answer.

notes.description: Notices: renamed/discontinued products, hints, flags. May be empty.

results.description: All topics in the knowledge base.

unverified_count.description: Count of [UNVERIFIED] items in the topic.

title: List glazing knowledge-base topics
